question: In the carbide slag-assisted steam gasification of sewage sludge at 700 °C, by what percentage did the H2 yield rise when Ca/C went from 0 to 0.75?
rendered:
The H2 yield rose from 207.40 mL g^− 1 to 332.85 mL g^− 1. 

To find the percentage increase, we use the formula: ((New Value - Old Value) / Old Value) * 100
= ((332.85 - 207.40) / 207.40) * 100
= (125.45 / 207.40) * 100
= 0.604 * 100
= 60.4%

The H2 yield rose by 60.4% when Ca/C went from 0 to 0.75.
